name: core-messaging-sendemail-error-fields-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: All owned rows are governed by compile-only or deterministic-mock action authority; this local exec fixture is policy-local-only and grants zero Salesforce parity credit.

evidence.notes: A locally rejected email exposes its required-field status code.
A locally rejected address-only email has no target object id.

source.content: Messaging.SingleEmailMessage invalid = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); invalid.setToAddresses(new List<String>{'missing-body@example.test'}); Messaging.SendEmailResult result = Messaging.sendEmail(new List<Messaging.SingleEmailMessage>{invalid}, false)[0]; System.assertEquals(false, result.isSuccess()); Messaging.SendEmailError errorValue = result.getErrors()[0]; System.assertEquals(StatusCode.REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, errorValue.statuscode); System.assertEquals(null, errorValue.targetobjectid);
